Card Q&A.a: Yes, both you and your opponent's Digimon were deleted, so you gain two memory.
Card Q&A.q: I have this Digimon in play when one of my other Digimon attacks, deletes an opponent's Digimon, and is deleted in return. Do I gain two memory?

Card Q&A.a: No, Security Digimon aren't considered to be Digimon, so you don't gain any memory.
Card Q&A.q: Do I gain 1 memory from this Digimon's effect when a Security Digimon is deleted?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, the +1 memory effect activates twice, earning you two memory.
Card Q&A.q: When I had this Digimon, another of my Digimon attacked, and both my Digimon and my opponent's Digimon were deleted in the battle. Do I gain 2 memory at such times?

Card Q&A.a: The effects trigger simultaneously, so the turn player gains a memory first, followed by the non-turn player gaining a memory, returning the memory gauge to its original position.
Card Q&A.q: My opponent and I both have this Digimon in play. If another Digimon is deleted, what happens?

Card Q&A.a: No. This Digimon was deleted, so the [All Turns] effect doesn't activate.
Card Q&A.q: If this Digimon attacks an opponent's Digimon and both Digimon end up being deleted, can I gain a memory off this card's effect?

Effect: ＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.)
[All Turns] When another Digimon is deleted, gain 1 memory for each Digimon deleted.
